compounds.name: butanoic acid

ammonia.reason: Low ureolysis/deamination in low-moisture cooked curd; no surface flora to release NH3.

animal_barnyard.reason: Raw cow alpine milk p-cresol/indole from pasture, restrained by cooked-pressed make.

bitter.reason: Long proteolysis balanced by Lactobacillus peptidases; low hydrophobic bitter peptides.

blue_moldy.reason: No Penicillium roqueforti inoculation and no blue veining; methyl ketones at background.

browning.reason: Low moisture plus proteolysis-derived free amino acids drive Maillard on heating.

buttery.reason: Diacetyl/acetoin from citrate metabolism plus lactones from cow milk fat lipolysis.

cheesy_sweaty.reason: Moderate 305 mg/kg butanoic acid from lipolysis/clostridial control; not pungent vs hard grating types.

creaminess.reason: 32% fat and 48% FDM with smooth cooked-pressed paste gives creamy mouthfeel despite firm body.

crumbliness.reason: Elastic cooked-pressed protein network deforms rather than fractures; not short/acid curd.

firmness.reason: Cooked to ~53-54C, pressed, moisture ~37% and 9-mo aging gives dense firm alpine body.

floral_honey.reason: Alpine pasture terpenes plus phenylacetaldehyde/phenylalanine catabolism in raw milk.

fruity.reason: Ethyl butanoate/hexanoate esterification by lactic acid bacteria during long ripening.

goaty.reason: Cow milk only; very low 4-methyloctanoic/4-ethyloctanoic branched-chain acids.

malty_nutty.reason: Signature hazelnut from Strecker 2-/3-methylbutanal and propionibacteria-light nutty notes.

melt.reason: Matured pH 5.7 calcium-solubilized para-casein flows well; classic fondue melter.

mushroom_earthy.reason: No bloomy or washed rind flora; 1-octen-3-ol at background only.

oil_off.reason: High FDM fat coalesces on heating but emulsified by intact protein; moderate free oil.

smoky.reason: Unsmoked make; no phenols from smoke exposure.

sour_vinegar.reason: Very low propionic 0.05-0.2 g/kg and low acetic; thermophilic starter deacidified.

stretch.reason: Non-pasta-filata rennet gel; melts to flow without mozzarella-like fibrous stretch.

sulfur_cooked.reason: Cooked curd drives some whey protein H2S/methional, but long aging dissipates sulfur.

sweet.reason: No residual lactose but sweet impression from glycerol, amino acids and diacetyl/lactones.

umami.reason: Extended proteolysis releases glutamate; high free amino acids without excessive salt.
